channel.title: Kobby — Blog
channel.description: Practical notes on branding, graphic design, motion and video, written for business owners and fellow creatives.

item.title: How to Brief a Designer: 10 Things to Include for Better Results
item.description: A clear brief saves time, money and frustration. Use this 10-point checklist to tell your designer exactly what you need, and get better work first time.

item.title: The 12 Principles of Animation, Explained for Motion Designers
item.description: Disney's 12 principles of animation are over 40 years old and still make motion graphics feel alive. Here is each one, with a practical tip you can use today.

item.title: Logo File Formats Explained: PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF and When to Use Each
item.description: Confused by all the logo file types? Here is a plain-English guide to PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF, AI and EPS, and which one to use for the web and for print.

item.title: Colour Contrast for Designers: Make Your Text Readable for Everyone
item.description: The contrast ratios that make text readable, what counts as large text, and a quick routine for checking every colour pairing in your designs.

item.title: What a Brand Identity Actually Includes (and What You Should Receive)
item.description: A logo is only the start. Here is what a full brand identity includes, and the questions to ask so you know exactly what you are paying for.
